local.notes: Actual user-local Docker Desktop CLI found; Linux container/build/Compose verified.

network.mirrorStatus: nginx:stable-alpine successfully pulled through configured daemon on 2026-10-12
network.interpretation: Direct-origin curl timeout does not establish failure of Docker pulls through the configured Tencent mirror. Configuring a mirror is not evidence it caused the direct-origin timeout.

recommendedDelivery.initial: Local Linux production build/test; Git fixed source/media/config inputs; Ubuntu builds from those same inputs; Compose and cloud acceptance.
recommendedDelivery.decisionBasis: Measure concrete image pulls via existing mirror, Git/npm access, cold/warm build time and peak memory, and actual artifact size/upload throughput.
recommendedDelivery.later: CI or local image build and verified registry delivery if cloud builds perform poorly; digest-based release.
recommendedDelivery.alternative: save/scp/load for offline or emergency delivery, with explicit full-archive bandwidth cost.

phasePlan.P1: Local Linux production build/test + explicitly authorized public cloud draft deployment
phasePlan.P2: Draft fixes, frozen inputs and pending deployment checks
phasePlan.P3: Runtime media preparation and versioned assets
phasePlan.P4: Production Docker validation, Git/server build and cloud deployment within requested scope
